name: 琉璃水母
evolution: 翡翠水母 → 琉璃水母 Lv.26
description: 身体的触手花纹会随心情变化，游动时非常漂亮。是海边生活的洛克的艺术灵感来源。然而它长长的触手可以释放多种效果的攻击，被它的美丽吸引注意时，可能会陷入危险哦。
descriptionEn: The patterns on its tentacles change with its mood, very beautiful when swimming. A source of artistic inspiration for Locks living by the sea. However its long tentacles can release various attacking effects; being attracted by its beauty may lead to danger.

skills.name: 甩水
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, restores 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 洗礼
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，并获得全技能能耗-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels own debuffs, and gains -1 to all skill costs.

skills.name: 不可接触
skills.description: 减伤50%，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能减伤+10%，应对攻击。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 50%, for each layer of Poison on enemy, this skill's damage reduction +10%, responds to attacks.

skills.name: 腐蚀酸液
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得2层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, enemy gains 2 layers of Poison.

skills.name: 以毒攻毒
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得魔攻+30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each layer of Poison on enemy, self gains M.ATK +30%.

skills.name: 瘴气喷射
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 泡沫幻影
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%, responds to attacks: self retreats.

skills.name: 激流
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 疫病吐息
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 1 layer of Poison Mark.

skills.name: 湮灭
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, for each layer of Poison on enemy, this skill's cost -1, enemy gains 1 layer of Poison.

skills.name: 鸩毒
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本次技能威力+10，应对状态：改为本次威力+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, for each layer of Poison on enemy, this skill's power +10, responds to status: instead this power +40.

skills.name: 天洪
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：本技能能耗永久-6。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, responds to status: this skill's cost permanently -6.
